content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

Conventional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy rent you access to their infrastructure. You get payment processing, product hosting, and delivery — until they shut you down. These platforms are centralized. They control the rules, the fees, and the off switch. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, flips this model. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), the backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), the order storage (Supabase), and the file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC. There’s no central platform to ban you. No subscriptions. No rent. The stack is deployed to your GitHub or Cloudflare account. You own the code, the data, and the infrastructure. It’s not a workaround. It’s a structural shift from renting to owning.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on financial risk assessments, not your business’s merit. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe, you’re locked out by default. Workarounds like using a U.S.-based friend’s account or VPN services are detected and banned. These platforms’ terms explicitly prohibit this behavior. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this exclusion by design. It doesn’t rely on any single platform’s approval. Cloudflare, Supabase, and GitHub operate globally without discriminating against specific countries. NOWPayments processes crypto payments from anywhere, with no buyer account required. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed in regions where conventional platforms fail. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and financial isolation. It’s not a solution for the privileged. It’s infrastructure built for the people Stripe locked out.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. They hold your funds for days or weeks, especially if you’re in a high-risk country. Crypto payments through NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no holding period. The payment confirms on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack integrates NOWPayments automatically. There’s no KYC for buyers or sellers. No buyer account is required. The real cost of sovereign infrastructure is the $197 deployment fee. After that, you own it. No monthly fees. No revenue share. Compare this to platforms that take 10-30% of your earnings and can shut you down at any time. The tradeoff is clear: pay once to own your infrastructure, or pay indefinitely to rent someone else’s.
Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on financial risk, not your business’s merit.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On Stripe or PayPal, your store, customer data, and payment history belong to them. If they ban you, you lose access to everything. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store is hosted on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Your backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The Edge Commerce Stack automates the entire process. Once a crypto payment is verified on-chain, the product is delivered instantly. You don’t lift a finger. COREMERCH deploys the stack to your accounts, but after delivery, they have no access. You own the keys. You control the data. This is not a platform you depend on. It’s infrastructure you own.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a country Stripe and PayPal support, and you’re okay with renting infrastructure, stick with them. But if you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Zimbabwe, or any restricted region, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software. It’s deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested. If you need full documentation to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint is $47. If you want COREMERCH to handle deployment, the Edge Commerce Stack is $197. Choose based on your technical skill and time. The result is the same: you own your infrastructure. No platform can shut you down. No country is excluded. This is not a workaround. It’s a structural alternative at the base layer.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 2. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Test end-to-end: payment verification to file delivery. 7. Deploy to your accounts. 8. Load your products. 9. Configure email delivery with SPF/DKIM/DMARC. 10. Launch your sovereign store.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can Stripe or PayPal ban my account even if I’m in a supported country?

Yes. Stripe and PayPal can ban accounts for perceived risk, policy violations, or even algorithmic flags. Once banned, there’s no appeal process. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this risk by removing centralized platforms from your architecture.
How does NOWPayments handle crypto volatility?

NOWPayments supports stablecoins like USDT and USDC, which are pegged to the USD. You can also accept payments in BTC, ETH, or other cryptocurrencies and convert them instantly to stablecoins to avoid volatility.
What if I don’t know how to code?

The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you. COREMERCH handles the technical setup, including backend logic, payment integration, and product loading. After deployment, the system is designed for non-technical users.
Can I use this stack if I’m not selling digital products?

The Edge Commerce Stack is optimized for digital products like ebooks, courses, and software. Physical products require additional logistics like shipping integration, which this stack does not include.
What happens if Cloudflare or GitHub bans my account?

Cloudflare and GitHub have stricter policies than payment platforms, but they ban accounts for legal violations, not financial risk. If your content is legal, your infrastructure remains secure. Always back up your code and data.
Owning your infrastructure means no platform can shut you down. Ever.
